consumer_contract.resource_kind: one independent Power icon PNG; not an atlas, Spine attachment, region, or animation frame
consumer_contract.gameplay_semantics: visible non-negative counter for Drain percentage points that expire when the owner's combat side turn ends

visual_review.semantic_result: A faceted cyan-blue life crystal is enclosed by one terminating purple-gold return arrow. A large hourglass and three-tick crescent timing arc make the one-turn duration explicit.
visual_review.persistent_icon_distinction: The persistent InfiniteDrainPower asset uses a broad horizontal infinity silhouette with symmetric twin loops. This icon is vertically compact, uses one circular pass with a visible arrow endpoint, and replaces the infinity silhouette with an hourglass and timing scale.
visual_review.small_size_result: At 64px the crystal, hourglass, timing arc, and one-pass arrow remain separate. At 32px the hourglass above the crystal and circular terminal arrow remain readable without text.

main_agent_review.result: The one-turn hourglass, timing ticks, cyan life crystal, and single terminating return ring remain clear at all three sizes and are visibly distinct from the persistent infinity-loop icon.

operation: prepare_vivhite_ui_icon.gd performed only uniform RGBA Lanczos resize plus centered transparent padding; no thresholding, mask, color key, Alpha repair, erosion, expansion, creative repaint, or generated-content change.
retry_decision: Accepted on attempt 1 of 8. Stop generation because the consumer, Alpha, SourceOver, temporary-duration distinction, safety-margin, forbidden-content, and actual-size gates all pass.
